mine.title: My Handover
mine.subtitle: The checklist of what you hand over, the notes a successor needs, and the capture interview.
mine.intro: Work through the checklist: every item to a person needs a short note, and the capture interview turns what only you know into Expert Insights.
mine.closedIntro: This handover is closed. The checklist and the interviews stay here for reference.
mine.nothingRequired: Nothing is required from you right now
mine.checklistHint: Grouped by what you own; the note on each item is what your successor reads first.

interview.title: Knowledge capture interview
interview.subtitle: The AI asks what a successor would ask: status, decisions, contacts, pitfalls and where things live. Answer by text or by voice, in either language.
interview.noTopicsHint: Topics come from your projects and tacit items; the administrator can add more.
interview.pickTopic: Pick a topic to begin or continue its interview.
interview.startHint: Five to eight questions, about ten minutes. Your answers become an Expert Insights lesson and notes on the related items.
interview.readyToComplete: The interview covered the ground. Complete it to file the answers.
interview.answerPlaceholder: Answer in your own words, in Arabic or English
interview.completedToast: Interview complete: an Expert Insights lesson was created
interview.noneYetHint: The person starts interviews from My Handover; they appear here read-only.

add.title: Add to handover

add.notePlaceholder: What it is, its status, where the rest lives
add.reviewHint: {count, plural, one {# item found} other {# items found}}. Untick what should not be filed, then publish into the handover.
add.notesPlaceholder: Type or paste what you hand over; the AI structures it into items

add.whereFromPlaceholder: A project, a meeting, a system

access.title: Handover access link
access.hint: A one-time link for an external person without an account: the checklist, uploads and the interview, until the last working day.
access.shownOnce: The link is shown once. Copy it now and send it to the person.

checks.items_decided: Every in-scope item has a recipient
checks.items_filed: Every item to the system is filed

close.overridePlaceholder: Why the handover closes although a check is open
close.overrideHint: The override is logged with your name.
close.readyHint: Every check passes. Closing archives the handover report into the Institutional Memory and pays the points.
close.notReadyToast: Not ready to close: give an override reason.
close.cutOffHintExternal: Ends the external access link now. Nothing happens automatically.
close.cutOffHintEmployee: Ends the person's sessions and locks the account now. Nothing happens automatically.
close.reportMissing: The report could not be rendered; the handover is closed without it.
close.reportHint: Rendered in both languages when the handover closes and archived as a report document.

token.invalid: This handover link is not valid
token.invalidHint: It may have expired on the last working day, been revoked, or the handover has closed. Ask your NPC counterpart for a new one.
token.title: Handover of {name}
token.intro: This workspace closes on your last working day. Add a note on every item, hand over any working papers, and, if you can, answer the short interview so your knowledge stays with the Council.
token.addTitle: Hand over a working paper or a note
token.footer: SiaNexus, the knowledge memory of the National Planning Council. This link is personal; do not forward it.
